bio: Jamie Petersen Ager (born November 18, 1977) is an American farmer, businessman, and politician who is the U.S. representative-elect for North Carolina's 11th congressional district. A member of the Democratic Party, Ager is the co-founder and chief executive of Hickory Nut Gap, a regenerative farm and locally sourced meat distributor based on his family's farm in Fairview, North Carolina.
